My strengths lie in economics and chemistry, where concepts feel more tangible and connected to real life. Math seems abstract and distant, making me prefer subjects that allow for more creative or practical application.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. The pressure of getting it right makes my heart race. I worry about looking foolish if I can't solve a problem quickly. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have used AI tools occasionally for quick explanations when stuck. It helps break down complex steps into simpler terms, which is comforting. However, I still feel a bit uneasy relying on it completely, preferring to understand concepts through traditional methods or trusted teachers.
